summary: Grand Canyon Caverns Airport serves the remote Peach Springs area in northwestern Arizona, providing access to the famous Grand Canyon Caverns, one of the largest dry cave systems in the United States. Situated on the Hualapai Reservation along historic Route 66, this small airfield primarily accommodates tourist, charter, and general aviation flights to the underground natural wonder located nearby.
faqs:
Q: What is Grand Canyon Caverns Airport used for?
A: The airport primarily serves tourists visiting the Grand Canyon Caverns, along with private and charter general aviation flights.

Q: Are there commercial airline services at PGS?
A: No,
